title: Texas license holders give the Information About Brokerage Services notice
rule: At the first substantive communication with a party about a transaction involving specific real property, a license holder gives that party TREC's Information About Brokerage Services notice, commercial deals included. Exceptions: a residential lease under one year with no sale considered, a party known to be represented by another license holder, and open-house talk about that property. Each license holder also links the notice from each business website's homepage. A license holder acting for itself; its spouse, parent or child; a trust it is trustee of or that benefits it or those relatives; or an entity it owns over 10% of, discloses its license in writing at or before contracting.

citation.authority: Tex. Occ. Code 1101.558(b-1) and (c); 22 Tex. Admin. Code 531.20 and 535.144

changeWatch: S.B. 1968 amended 1101.558 effective January 1, 2026, and TREC's current notice is IABS 1-2; watch for later changes to the statute, TREC rules 531.20 and 535.144, or the form.
